title: Revenue trend line drops to $0 on days with no sales between two sales days
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as {User-A} (for example Admin ShopView), whose role has the Reports permission, at location {Location-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST Gap Days 14 Oct A).
  • Your browser window is at least 1024 pixels wide at 100% zoom (a maximised laptop or desktop window).
  • This month {Location-A} has invoices on exactly two days, {Day-A} and {Day-B} (for example the 3rd and the 9th), at least two days apart, and no invoice on any day between them.
  • Today is {Day-B} or a later day of the same month.
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top bar (the Revenue tile opens on This Month).
  2. Look at the Revenue tile's trend line between {Day-A} and {Day-B}.
  3. Hover the trend line on a day between {Day-A} and {Day-B} and read the value, if one is shown.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: The trend line is one continuous line: it drops to the bottom of the trend area on the days with no sales and rises again at {Day-B}. It does not break into separate pieces or single dots.
  • Step 2: It is not the dashed empty-chart outline.
  • Step 3: The day between reads $0.00. If hovering shows no value, write "values not checked by hand" in the result comment.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9576 (Story 4, KPI Hero Tiles); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850, version 48 (14 Oct 2026, 17:09 UTC, Chris Ward), S4-R11a (added in version 43 on 9 Oct 2026, 15:41 UTC, by Chris Ward with the note "no-sales bucket is a 0 point (SV-11076)"; the spec's change log (version 46) lists it under 2026-10-09; Chris Ward's comment on Jira SV-11076, 9 Oct 2026), S4-R11b (added in version 45 on 14 Oct 2026 (15:06 UTC) by Chris Ward) and S4-E3; read 14 Oct 2026. Page change: https://shopview.atlassian.net/wiki/pages/diffpagesbyversion.action?pageId=788430850&selectedPageVersions=42&selectedPageVersions=43. Source-verified 14 October 2026. Not yet checked against a build.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R11a: “On Revenue and the count tiles, a bucket with no sales is a point at 0. Only a ratio tile's "-" (S3-E3) contributes no point.”
  • S4-R11b: “The sparkline shows direction, not level. Each tile scales its line between its own lowest and highest point, so a figure that never changes over the range (for example Technician Utilization at 100% on every day) draws as a flat line along the bottom of the trend area, whatever the figure is. The headline carries the actual value. The start-at-0 axis of S9-R8 applies to the expanded and report charts, which have an axis, not to the sparkline.”
  • S4-E3: “A range where every point is zero except one shows the sparkline, because not every point is zero.”
